dedupe_keys.name: building type classification images from satellite imagery us seven classes

description: This Zenodo dataset holds 1,553 satellite images of individual buildings in the United States, labelled into seven classes for training building type classifiers: commercial (206), high-rise (294), hospital (204), industrial (217), multi-family (220), schools (206) and single-family (206). Images are 512 by 512 pixels at about 0.15 metres per pixel and were collected from Google Earth. The creator, Madhu Goutham Reddy Ambati, used them to train a DenseNet201 model reported at 84.40% classification accuracy. Coverage: buildings across the United States. Access: one ZIP file of about 0.93 GB on Zenodo, published 2026-02-07. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 as stated on the record; free. Caveats: the images come from Google Earth, whose own terms may restrict reuse whatever the record licence says; the set is small and balanced by design, the exact locations are not given, and the accuracy figure is the creator's own. Simulation uses are training models that tag building footprints with occupancy types, including hospitals and schools, to enrich exposure inventories for hazard impact modelling. Related records: the Google Open Buildings and FEMA USA Structures footprint records.
